Interactive viewing: Sing along to the catchy tunes, giggle at the playful sound effects, and be mesmerized by the vibrant animation.

What would you do if you knew there was an alligator under your bed? You could try to tell your parents but you know they would never be able to see it. It's going to be up to you or in this case up to that courageous little fellow who conquered the nightmare in There's a Nightmare in My Closet. This time he has more tricks up his pajama sleeve. How will our valiant hero lure the alligator out and get rid of him for once and for all? The ending leads to a whole different story possibility but we'll just leave that to your imagination.
